description.value: A 32-site BC Parks campground on the north-western shore of Kootenay Lake, reached via paved Hwy. 31 about 25 km north of Kaslo, with sheltered lakeview sites and easy beach access for paddling and swimming (water runs cold). Purcell mountain panoramas, WiFi, and an upgraded drinking water system make it a comfortable base for fishing, hiking, and on-water activities.

address.value: Kooteney Lake Provincial Park, #1, Central Kootenay, BC V0G 1N0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Davis Creek Campground as an active 32-site facility within Kootenay Lake Park, corroborating the OSM capacity tag and camp_site classification. The website explicitly references a recent 'upgrade to the drinking water system' supporting potable water, and states Cove Loop campsites are available on the BC Parks reservations system. Notably, the website directly contradicts the OSM internet_access=no tag by advertising 'newly installed WiFi' at Davis Creek, so the website is treated as authoritative per the rules.
concerns: OSM tag internet_access=no contradicts the BC Parks website, which advertises 'newly installed WiFi' at Davis Creek; website treated as authoritative.

OSM phone (+1-250-825-4212) and email (anne@kootenayswparks.com) appear to belong to the private operator RAP Park Contracting Ltd., not BC Parks directly; contact details could change if operator changes.
Website URL resolves to the broader Kootenay Lake Park page covering multiple campgrounds; some amenity details may apply park-wide rather than specifically to Davis Creek.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground with 32 sites, potable water, WiFi, and reservations on the Kootenay Lake touring route — a clear fit for the WWC cycling tourism directory.
